title: Display right-now summary in kbs show and issue detail
description:
Show the cached right-now summary on kbs show / kanbus show and in the console TaskDetailPanel. Missing summaries render as (no right-now summary). JSON show already serializes IssueData fields.

Specs: features/issues/issue_show.feature and features/console/issue_detail_metadata.feature.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Epic 9 complete: show and issue detail surface right-now summaries.

right_now_summary: Right-now summaries now appear in `kbs show` and the issue detail panel, with a placeholder when missing.
